name: surogate-desktop
description: Surogate Desktop: lets an agent's tools work on a folder of your computer.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/shell/pages && cp src/shell/pages/*.html src/shell/pages/*.css dist/shell/pages/
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron dist/shell/main.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && xvfb-run -a vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts
